I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input clk
 - input d
 - input q

The module should implement a single D flip-flop. Assume all sequential
logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input clk
 - input d
 - input q

The module should implement a single D flip-flop. Assume all sequential
logic is triggered on the positive edge of the clock.

Write the complete SystemVerilog implementation of TopModule.
Respond with a single ```verilog code block containing the full module and nothing else.

content.text:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input d,
    output reg q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
    q <= d;
end

endmodule
```
